nodes.description: Private mapping of holder balances used by _transfer and balanceOf.
Private nested mapping of owner->spender allowances written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Fixed total supply of 1000*10**9*10**18 tokens assigned to the deployer in the constructor.
Owner address stored by Ownable, read by owner(), _approve, transferOwnership and renounceOwnership.
Shadow owner variable initialized to _msgSender() at declaration and actually used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner.
Token name string constant ' Noelle Inu  ' returned by name().
Token symbol string 'Noelle' returned by symbol().
Token decimals (18) returned by decimals().
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender() and used for authorization and token transfers.
Internal transfer routine that debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient] using SafeMath.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding _msgSender() and recipient to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and then rewrites the allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Private approval routine that zeroes out allowances when the owner argument is not the contract owner, otherwise stores the given amount.
Owner-restricted transfer of _owner to newOwner; private and gated by the flawed onlyOwner modifier.
Owner-restricted function setting _owner to address(0) and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Public view returning the stored _owner address.
Modifier enforcing newComer == _msgSender() instead of comparing against _owner.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning the immutable _tTotal supply.
Noelle constructor minting the entire _tTotal supply to _msgSender().
Public view returning the _name string.
Public view returning the _symbol string.
Public view returning the _decimals value.
Conditional allowance wipe in _approve that silently forces non-owner allowances to zero, breaking transferFrom for regular users.
Access-control comparison against the stale newComer variable rather than _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Destination address argument of transfer().
Token amount argument of transfer().
Source address argument of transferFrom().
Destination address argument of transferFrom().
Token amount argument of transferFrom().
Spender address argument of approve().
Allowance amount argument of approve().
Owner address argument of the private _approve helper.
Spender address argument of the private _approve helper.
Allowance amount argument of the private _approve helper.
Debited address argument of _transfer.
Credited address argument of _transfer.
Amount argument of _transfer.
New owner address argument of transferOwnership().
Local variable caching _msgSender() inside the constructor for minting and event emission.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender address into _transfer, letting the caller move their own balance.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
approve() forwards _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against the stale newComer state variable.
Constructor mints the entire supply to _msgSender().
Caller address reaches the allowance-reset branch of _approve and determines whether the allowance is zeroed.
Caller address is compared with newComer in the flawed ownership check.
newComer is initialized from _msgSender() at declaration time, freezing authorization to the deployer.
Constructor local cache is assigned from _msgSender().
Cached caller address is used by the constructor for the initial balance assignment.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
balanceOf returns the _balances entry for the queried account.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to subtract the spent amount.
_approve writes the _allowances[ol][tt] slot.
Constructor assigns _tTotal as the initial balance of the deployer.
totalSupply returns the stored _tTotal value.
_approve branches on whether ol equals owner(), wiping allowances for non-owner callers.
owner() returns the stored _owner address.
transferOwnership reassigns _owner to newOwner.
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with address(0).
onlyOwner gates privileged functions using newComer rather than _owner.
The flawed authorization check reads the newComer state variable.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve() delegates to the private _approve helper.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership.
The unsafe allowance-zeroing branch executes inside _approve.
transferFrom reaches the allowance-reset path through _approve, disabling normal allowances.
The incorrect newComer-based check is executed by the onlyOwner modifier.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded from transfer() into _transfer.
sender parameter is forwarded from transferFrom() into _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded from transferFrom() into _transfer.
amount parameter is used by transferFrom() for the balance and allowance subtraction.
spender parameter is forwarded from approve() into _approve.
amount parameter is forwarded from approve() into _approve.
ol parameter selects the allowance slot owner in _approve.
tt parameter selects the allowance slot spender in _approve.
amount parameter is the value written into _allowances when the caller is the owner.
sender parameter is debited in _transfer.
recipient parameter is credited in _transfer.
amount parameter is added/subtracted in _transfer.
newOwner parameter replaces the stored _owner address.
Constructor initializes _balances[_msgSender()] with the full supply.
Construction sets _owner, while newComer is fixed at declaration time, decoupling the two.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only meaningful as the destination argument consumed by transfer().
amount is only meaningful as the value argument consumed by transfer().
sender exists solely as the debited account argument of transferFrom().
recipient exists solely as the credited account argument of transferFrom().
amount is consumed by transferFrom() when subtracting balance and allowance.
spender is only used as the approval target argument of approve().
amount is only used as the approved value argument of approve().
ol is the allowance owner key handled entirely inside _approve.
tt is the allowance spender key handled entirely inside _approve.
amount is the value written to the allowance slot inside _approve.
sender is the balance source handled entirely inside _transfer.
recipient is the balance destination handled entirely inside _transfer.
amount is the moved value handled entirely inside _transfer.
newOwner is the single argument written into _owner by transferOwnership.
msgSender is a temporary cache used only by the constructor for minting and the Transfer event.
